type.provenance: After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six, no person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals or that contain perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation.
